mapper.insert: INSERT INTO novel_book_illustration (volume_id, sort_order, url, original_name, created_at) VALUES (#{volumeId}, #{sortOrder}, #{url}, #{originalName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, volume_id, sort_order, url, original_name, created_at FROM novel_book_illustration WHERE volume_id = #{volumeId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
